sources.title: 【電源供應器】台達電(2308)的復甦之路，從何觀察？
sources.effective_period: Forecast as of 2024-05-09; target supply period not specified.
sources.note: Says a supply-chain survey expected Delta to become a main AC/DC PSU supplier in DGX GB200; the survey and its methodology are not identified.

sources.title: Delta Presents Comprehensive Solutions for AI Data Center with Containerized Data Center & HVDC Power Solution at COMPUTEX 2025
sources.effective_period: Product and solution disclosures as of COMPUTEX 2025.
sources.locator: Press release, “Power Solutions and Thermal Management for AI Data Centers” and “HVDC Solutions”
sources.note: Confirms Delta publicly offered AC/DC power shelves and GB200-related solutions, but does not confirm Delta as a main DGX GB200 AC/DC PSU supplier.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
已找到精確對應原文的二手報導及 Delta 後續官方產品披露；在所查資料中未找到可核實 CSP 特定排名的具名客戶資料、排名分母或 DGX GB200 兩類電源供應商的官方確認。
最大供應商的表述來自二手分析文章，未提供具名 CSP、排名比較範圍、市占率或其他可核對的分母。
DGX GB200 兩項供應商預測均追溯至同一篇二手文章所引述的供應鏈調查；調查來源、方法、預測期間及「主要」的衡量標準均未披露。
Delta 2025 年官方資料確認其相關產品與 GB200 解決方案，但未確認其為 DGX GB200 的 DC/DC 或 AC/DC 主要供應商。
